items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: A fella named Weber played clarinet. Freddie New Roth played trumpet. Red Rolling played clarinet later. Jack played trombone. And Johnny Frisco played drums and I played piano.

ctx.x: just two of them left? Oh, no, just me. Yeah, there are three or four of them at Goldman? Sure. All the band left

but me. Left me high and dry. So I told him in a couple of nights, I can get you another Dixieland band. I feel confident that I can. So I got in touch with my brother Jack and told him to get a hold of some of the fellas that he thought could play. So he got a hold of four other guys and I wired them the money and they caught the train and came on. A fella named Weber played clarinet. Freddie New Roth played trumpet.
